test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is Nomophobia?

options.text: Fear of being out of home contact
Fear of being out of cellular phone contact
Fear of being out of television contact
Fear of being out of computer contact

solution:
The correct answer is __**Fear of being out of cellular phone contact.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Psychological condition** when **people have a fear of being detached from mobile phone connectivity**.
 
• It most likely stems from **increased reliance on technology and concern over what might happen if you suddenly couldn't access needed information.**
 
• This can lead to** anxiety, depression and isolation, as well as physical problems such as headaches.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• A phobia is an **anxiety disorder defined by a persistent and excessive fear of an object or situation**.
 
• Phobias typically result in a **rapid onset of fear and are usually present for more than six months.**
 
• **Some of the most common phobias are:**
 
 
• **​**Social Phobia: The Fear of Judgment or Rejection
 
• Arachnophobia: The Fear of Spiders
 
• Agoraphobia: The Fear of Open or Crowded Spaces
 
• Claustrophobia: The Fear of Tight Spaces
 
• Acrophobia: The Fear of Heights
